Create exactly ONE new original Small Seal script glyph based on the attached four-specimen Unicode reference. No swelling, taper, pointed tips, brush pressure, serif, texture or outline of brush silhouettes. Keep essential branches, short marks, counters, attachments, separations and relative bar lengths explicit. Important small gaps must stay open.

ONE finished glyph centered in the central 70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. Pure BLACK strokes on fully TRANSPARENT background. The central stem continues below the lower U and curves slightly right. Compare all four: some attach motifs and close small loops. Choose the coherent open whole construction with THREE motifs detached from each other and no little enclosed loops, attested by THX, without importing other specimens' joined alternatives. Beneath the three motifs is a SHORT detached central horizontal. Below it is a much LONGER horizontal, joined only to its central descending stem; two detached curved downward flank strokes sit under that long bar. Exactly THREE bottom descenders, central one straight. Preserve both U levels in each of the three motifs (six U-shaped arms total), short bar longer-gap from baseline, and motif detachments.
